title: Izikali Ezawela Encithakalweni
intro: Esifundeni esinothile nesichumayo, umphakathi ochumayo wavumela ukuhaha ukuba konakalise imakethe. Laziwa ngamakhono okuhweba kanye nobuningi obuvela ezingadini ezizungezile, leli qembu labhekana nobizo lokulunga nokholo. Kodwa ukuziqhenya ngengcebo kwaholela ekungalalelini, futhi ithunzi elimnyama lahlangana ekugcineni.
clues: Sasiwumphakathi ochumayo wezohwebo ohlala phakathi kwezingadi nezihlahla ezinamahlathi.
Sakhohlisa abantu ngezilinganiso nangezilinganiso, sasakaza inkohlakalo ezweni.
Saxwayiswa yisithunywa sethu ukuba sikhonze u-Allah kuphela futhi sinikeze isilinganiso esigcwele.
Sahleka usulu isithunywa sethu futhi safuna isijeziso uma sikhuluma iqiniso.
Sabanjwa yisijeziso soSuku lwethunzi lapho ifu lisibekela.
Ngaziwa ngokuthi ngabangane basehlathini, abantu okwathunyelwa kubo uShu'ayb.
